result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred insurance requirements: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, conditional cyber coverage at USD 5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing provisions. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after termination exceeds the stated playbook and is not necessary, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation. The clause is otherwise professionally drafted, though using the agreement’s defined term “Customer Data,” if available, would improve precision.
